profile.name: Eeon

capabilities.summary_en: Android lifecycle, networking, debugging, WebRTC, release discipline, and device-level diagnosis.

capabilities.summary_en: Typed APIs, web interfaces, data stores, CI, access boundaries, and deployable demonstrations.
capabilities.summary_zh: 具備型別化 API、Web 介面、資料儲存、CI、存取邊界與可部署 Demo。

capabilities.summary_en: Portable SKILL.md procedures, tool contracts, state machines, context routing, and delivery loops.
capabilities.summary_zh: 建立可攜式 SKILL.md 程序、工具契約、狀態機、上下文路由與交付迴圈。

capabilities.summary_en: Deterministic verdicts, evidence receipts, mutation controls, fail-closed gates, and regression checks.
capabilities.summary_zh: 使用確定性判定、證據收據、變異控制、Fail-closed 閘門與回歸檢查。

capabilities.area_zh: Android 與 iOS 裝置自動化
capabilities.summary_en: Local-first control planes for simulator and real-device operation, diagnosis, bounded repair, and evidence.
capabilities.summary_zh: 建立 Local-first 控制平面，支援模擬器與真機操作、診斷、受限修復與證據留存。

capabilities.area_zh: 後訓練與 Model/Harness 共演化
capabilities.summary_en: Typed control records, data admission, immutable lineage, human approval, rollback, and audit paths.

projects.title: Skill.md-native
projects.summary_en: Wrapperless Skill invocation, AST lint, assertion-driven repair, and evidence-first reports.
projects.summary_zh: 實作無包裝 Skill 呼叫、AST Lint、斷言驅動修復與 Evidence-first 報告。
projects.proof_en: Executable checks and documented pass evidence are present in the repository.
projects.proof_zh: Repository 內含可執行檢查與已記錄的通過證據。

projects.title: Agent Skills Registry
projects.summary_en: Vendor-neutral Agent Skills registry with provenance, deterministic scripts, typed CI, and MCP integration.
projects.summary_zh: Vendor-neutral Agent Skills Registry，包含來源追蹤、確定性腳本、型別化 CI 與 MCP 整合。
projects.proof_en: Portable Skill packages and validation workflows are published.
projects.proof_zh: 已公開可攜式 Skill 套件與驗證工作流。

projects.title: OpenWiki Source Anchoring
projects.summary_en: Full-stack knowledge system with source anchoring, access controls, offline behavior, and browser-level validation.
projects.summary_zh: 具備來源錨定、存取控制、離線行為與瀏覽器層驗證的全端知識系統。
projects.proof_en: Architecture, application stack, and CI paths are public.
projects.proof_zh: 架構、應用技術棧與 CI 路徑已公開。

projects.title: Truth Verify Loop
projects.summary_en: Eval-first claim verification with retrieval checks, deterministic gates, and CI regression evidence.
projects.summary_zh: Eval-first 宣稱驗證，整合檢索檢查、確定性閘門與 CI 回歸證據。
projects.proof_en: The repository publishes the verification flow, CLI, and evaluation contracts.
projects.proof_zh: Repository 已公開驗證流程、CLI 與評測契約。

projects.title: Blackbox Auto Research
projects.summary_en: Multi-agent black-box research orchestration with contradiction analysis and confidence-aware validation.
projects.summary_zh: 多 Agent 黑箱研究編排，包含矛盾分析與信心感知驗證。
projects.proof_en: The orchestration and validation design is publicly inspectable.
projects.proof_zh: 編排與驗證設計可公開檢視。

projects.title: XT-Aegis
projects.summary_en: Agent-assisted mobile application security analysis with typed services, trace evidence, and deployment infrastructure.
projects.summary_zh: Agent 輔助的行動應用安全分析，包含型別化服務、Trace 證據與部署基礎設施。
projects.proof_en: The public repository exposes architecture, services, and deployment paths.
projects.proof_zh: 公開 Repository 呈現架構、服務與部署路徑。

projects.title: Post-Training RSI Pipeline
projects.summary_en: Evidence-first post-training pipeline with resumable state, immutable lineage, approvals, rollback, and audit.
projects.summary_zh: Evidence-first 後訓練 Pipeline，支援可恢復狀態、不可變血緣、核准、回滾與稽核。
projects.proof_en: Local deterministic behavior is implemented. Live cloud or GPU performance is not claimed.
projects.proof_zh: 已實作本機確定性行為；不宣稱已具備 Live Cloud 或 GPU 效能證據。

projects.title: Android & iOS Device Autopilot
projects.summary_en: Local-first automation for simulators and real devices, with bounded actions, repair loops, and redacted evidence.
projects.summary_zh: Local-first 模擬器與真機自動化，具備受限動作、修復迴圈與去識別化證據。
projects.proof_en: Detailed implementation remains private. A sanitized architecture and live demonstration can be provided for qualified work.
projects.proof_zh: 詳細實作維持私有；合適合作可提供去敏架構與 Live Demo。

projects.title: ix-agy-private — Integration Lab
projects.summary_en: The career bridge from Android engineering to full-stack delivery, mobile E2E automation, and agentic control systems.
projects.summary_zh: 呈現從 Android 工程走向全端交付、行動 E2E 自動化與 Agentic 控制系統的職涯橋接。
projects.proof_en: Employer, customer, product, credential, and proprietary adapter details are intentionally excluded.
projects.proof_zh: 刻意排除雇主、客戶、產品、憑證與專有 Adapter 細節。

projects.title: Skills Shared Control Plane
projects.summary_en: Canonical cross-repository Skills, verifier calibration, mutation controls, evidence bundles, and release admission.
projects.summary_zh: 跨 Repository 的 Canonical Skills、Verifier 校準、變異控制、證據 Bundle 與 Release Admission。
projects.proof_en: Public résumé exposes the transferable method, not the private registry or runtime bindings.
projects.proof_zh: 公開履歷只呈現可轉移方法，不公開私有 Registry 或 Runtime Bindings。

roles.current_en: Strong fit for decomposition, mobile and legacy integration, device automation, documentation, and bounded delivery.
roles.current_zh: 適合需求拆解、行動與 Legacy 整合、裝置自動化、文檔與受限交付。

roles.next_zh: 公開更多 Client-shaped Case Study，加入前後指標與驗收收據。

roles.next_zh: 補上 Live GPU Inference、Model Serving Benchmark 與成本或延遲量測。

steps_en: Split one action into each task.
steps_zh: 每個任務只放一個動作。
